Agent Name: **Planner**  
Step Number: **2**  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Wikipedia-provided birth date of "11 September 1962" as "11/09/1962" (the MM/DD format) instead of recognizing it as the DD/MM format. As a result, the Planner incorrectly converted the date to "November 9, 1962" instead of the correct "September 11, 1962." This incorrect conversion of date formatting occurred due to an improper understanding of the regional (Swedish) date formatting standard, combined with the Planner's attempt to normalize the format to MM/DD without recognizing this error. Despite repeatedly revisiting the Wikipedia page, the Planner did not correct this initial error, leading to the propagation of the wrong solution throughout the later steps.
